title: Database changes include rollback guidance
description: Every changed database migration must document how it can be reversed or why it is irreversible.
remediation: Add a down migration, rollback section, or an explicit irreversible migration explanation.

title: Infrastructure changes identify an owner
description: Infrastructure and deployment changes must identify the team or person responsible for rollout.
remediation: Add an owner or team annotation to the change, or supply owner metadata with the review request.

title: Authentication changes require security review
description: Changes to authentication, authorization, sessions, or permissions require explicit security review.
remediation: Obtain security approval and attach the review reference to the change.

title: CI must complete without failures
description: Failed CI commands, tests, and build steps block deployment.
remediation: Resolve each reported CI failure and rerun the pipeline.

title: Secrets must not be committed
description: Added source lines must not contain credentials, API keys, private keys, or tokens.
remediation: Remove the credential, rotate it, and reference a managed secret or environment variable instead.
